DomainData.MainInfoText: Nuair a thugann tú cuairt ar aon suíomh gréasáin, d’fhéadfadh sé eolas a stóráil ar do bhrabhsálaí nó a aisghabháil uaidh. Is iondúil go mbíonn an t-eolas sin i bhfoirm fianán. D’fhéadfadh sé go mbaineann an fhaisnéis sin leatsa, le do roghanna, do ghléas nó d’fhéadfaí í a úsáid chun an suíomh a chur ag obair mar a bheifí ag súil leis. Is iondúil nach mbíonn tú inaitheanta go díreach leis an bhfaisnéis, ach tá sé in ann eispéireas gréasáin níos pearsantaithe a thabhairt duit. Is féidir leat gan cineálacha faoi leith fianán a cheadú. Cliceáil ar na teidil éagsúla catagóire chun tuilleadh eolais a fháil agus chun ár réamhshocruithe a athrú. Ba cheart a bheith ar an eolas, mar sin féin, go bhféadfadh sé cur isteach ar d’eispéireas ar an suíomh agus ar na seirbhísí ar féidir linn iad a thairiscint duit má bhlocálann tú cineálacha faoi leith fianán.
DomainData.AlertNoticeText: Úsáidimid fianáin chun go bhfeidhmeoidh ár suíomh i gceart, chun inneachar agus fógraí a phearsantú, chun gnéithe a bhaineann leis na meáin shóisialta a chur ar fáil agus chun anailís a dhéanamh ar ár dtrácht. Roinnimid faisnéis faoin úsáid a bhaineann tú as ár suíomh lenár gcomhpháirtithe meán sóisialta, fógraíochta agus anailísíochta.Cookie Notice

DomainData.CookieListDescription: Is e pìos beag dàta (faidhle teacsa) a th’ ann am briosgaid a dh’ iarras làrach-lìn – nuair a bhios neach-cleachdaidh a’ tadhal air – a stòradh air an inneal agad gus cuimhne a chumail air fiosrachadh mur deidhinn, leithid do roghainn cànain no fiosrachadh logaidh a-steach. Tha na briosgaidean sin air an suidheachadh leinn agus canar briosgaidean ciad-phàrtaidh riutha. Bidh sinn cuideachd a’ cleachdadh briosgaidean treas-phàrtaidh - a tha nam briosgaidean bho raon eadar-dhealaichte bho raon na làraich-lìn air a bheil thu a’ tadhal - airson ar n-oidhirpean sanasachd is margaidheachd. Gu sònraichte, bidh sinn a’ cleachdadh briosgaidean agus teicneòlasan tracadh eile airson nan adhbharan a leanas:

Groups.GroupDescription: Tha na briosgaidean seo riatanach airson gum bi an làrach-lìn ag obair agus chan urrainnear an cur dheth anns na siostaman againn. Mar as trice chan eil iad air an suidheachadh ach mar fhreagairt do ghnìomhan a nì thu mar iarrtas airson seirbheisean, leithid a bhith a’ suidheachadh do roghainnean prìobhaideachd, a’ logadh a-steach no a’ lìonadh fhoirmean. Faodaidh tu do bhrobhsair a shuidheachadh gus na briosgaidean sin a bhacadh no rabhadh a thoirt dhut, ach chan obraich cuid de phàirtean den làrach an uairsin. Cha bhith na briosgaidean sin a’ stòradh fiosrachadh sam bith a dh’ aithnicheas tu gu pearsanta.

FirstPartyCookies.description: This cookie name is associated with the Amazon Web Services Elastic Load Balancing functionality for routing client request on the server.

FirstPartyCookies.Name: OptanonConsent
FirstPartyCookies.description: This cookie is set by the cookie compliance solution from OneTrust. It stores information about the categories of cookies the site uses and whether visitors have given or withdrawn consent for the use of each category. This enables site owners to prevent cookies in each category from being set in the users browser, when consent is not given. The cookie has a normal lifespan of one year, so that returning visitors to the site will have their preferences remembered. It contains no information that can identify the site visitor.

FirstPartyCookies.description: This AWS cookie is used for load balancing.

FirstPartyCookies.Name: OptanonAlertBoxClosed
FirstPartyCookies.description: This cookie is set by websites using certain versions of the cookie law compliance solution from OneTrust.  It is set after visitors have seen a cookie information notice and in some cases only when they actively close the notice down.  It enables the website not to show the message more than once to a user.  The cookie has a one year lifespan and contains no personal information.

Groups.GroupDescription: Leigidh na briosgaidean seo leinn tursan agus tobraichean trafaic a chunntadh gus an urrainn dhuinn coileanadh ar làrach a thomhas agus a leasachadh. Bidh iad gar cuideachadh gus faighinn a-mach dè na duilleagan as mòr-chòrdte agus as lugha fèill agus faicinn mar a bhios luchd-tadhail a’ gluasad timcheall na làraich. Tha a h-uile fiosrachadh a bhios na briosgaidean sin a’ cruinneachadh cruinn agus mar sin gun urra. Mura ceadaich thu na briosgaidean seo cha bhi fios againn nuair a thadhail thu air an làrach againn, agus chan urrainn dhuinn sùil a chumail air a choileanadh.

FirstPartyCookies.description: This cookie name is associated with Google Universal Analytics. This appears to be a new cookie and as of Spring 2017 no information is available from Google.  It appears to store and update a unique value for each page visited._gid

FirstPartyCookies.Name: _gat
FirstPartyCookies.description: This cookie name is associated with Google Universal Analytics, according to documentation it is used to throttle the request rate - limiting the collection of data on high traffic sites. It expires after 10 minutes.

FirstPartyCookies.Name: _ga
FirstPartyCookies.description: This cookie name is associated with Google Universal Analytics - which is a significant update to Google's more commonly used analytics service. This cookie is used to distinguish unique users by assigning a randomly generated number as a client identifier. It is included in each page request in a site and used to calculate visitor, session and campaign data for the sites analytics reports.  By default it is set to expire after 2 years, although this is customisable by website owners.
